title: Stale Stars-history and received-gifts errors are not matched to the live request
trigger: Open Stars, tap Incoming then Outgoing (or open gifts of channel A, close, open gifts of user B). The first request fails or is swept after its TTL (408) after the second was sent.
effect: The older failure sets tx_loading=false and tx_error (or gifts_loading=false, gifts_error) while the newer request is in flight, or over an already loaded list. The dialog shows an error, the spinner stops, and maybe_fetch_star_transactions can send a duplicate. Answers are matched by tx_request/gifts_request, errors are not (Grams does match them).
fix: Apply GetStarTransactions/GetReceivedGifts errors only when pending.id equals tx_request/gifts_request, as apply_grams_error does; better, hold the history as Fetch<Page> keyed by request id.

title: getGiftCollections answer is applied to whichever owner's list is open
trigger: Open your own gifts, then at once a channel's gifts (reset_for_owner + new fetch); the first fetch answers after the second.
effect: Collection tabs of the wrong owner show (and collections_loading drops early); picking one asks the channel for a collection id that is not its own.
fix: Carry the owner in PaymentsPurpose::GetGiftCollections and apply only when it equals hub.gifts_owner.

title: Errors of resale search, auction state and craft candidates are not matched to the request that failed
trigger: Change a resale filter twice quickly (or tap auction A then auction B, or reopen the craft box) while the older request fails.
effect: The older error clears loading on the newer search (search.loading / auction_loading / candidates_loading), marks loaded with an error, and for auctions clears pending_auction so B's box never opens; a resale error also hits the craft market search when both are loading.
fix: Compare the failed request id with request_id / auction_request / candidates_request before touching the stage, as the Buy and Craft arms already do.

title: Bank card lookup answer is applied to whichever card is current
trigger: Tap card number A, then card number B before A answers (request_bank_card_info replaces bank_card)
effect: apply.rs:17-24 only checks the purpose, so A's info lands in B's lookup; entity_links.rs:486-495 compares only lookup.number == the tapped number, so B's popup shows A's issuer title and open-URL actions (a different bank's links). Error arm error.rs:56-61 also clears B's loading
fix: Store the RequestId in the lookup (Fetch<info> enum Loading{request}/Ready/Failed) and apply only on a match, as GiftCodeLookup does.

title: state_requested and rates_requested are set before the send and cleared only in the error arm
trigger: Open the Money page when the send fails (closed channel, client closing) or the answer is lost to a dropped continuation
effect: connect/ton_wallet.rs:80-92 sets the flag then uses `?` on send_wallet; a send failure returns early with the flag still true, so later opens never request the wallet state or rates and the page shows no balance until restart. Only TDLib errors reach ton_wallet.rs:130-131 which reset them
fix: Fetch<WalletState>/Fetch<Rates> (Idle/Loading/Ready/Failed) where a send failure returns to Idle.

title: Boosts Show more does not set loading, so a double click sends the page twice and the button shows no progress
trigger: Open Boosts as an admin of a channel with more than 25 boosts, then double-click Show more.
effect: request_chat_boosts only sets state.request (not loading) on the append path, and load_more_chat_boosts guards on state.loading, so the guard never fires; two getChatBoosts go out for the same offset, the first answer is dropped as stale, and no spinner shows while the page loads. A failed send on the append path also removes the whole list.
fix: Replace loading/error/request with one enum Page { Idle, Loading(RequestId), Failed(String) } (or Fetch) so the guard and the stale check read the same value.

title: Payment receipt Total leaves out the tip and the shipping cost
trigger: Pay a bot invoice with a tip (or a flexible invoice with a paid shipping option), then open the receipt from the 'Payment successful' service message.
effect: The receipt's Total row shows only the sum of invoice.price_parts; the tip is listed on its own row but not added, and shipping_option.price_parts are dropped entirely, so the Total is less than what the card was charged.
fix: In parse_payment_receipt sum invoice.price_parts + shipping_option.price_parts + tip_amount (as tdesktop does), or keep the parts and let the dialog compute the total from all three.

title: currency_exponent misses zero-decimal currencies Telegram uses (ISK)
trigger: Open an invoice, checkout or receipt priced in Icelandic krona (ISK), which Telegram's currency table lists with exponent 0.
effect: The amount is divided by 100 and shown as e.g. 'ISK 19.99' instead of 'ISK 1999', so the price shown before paying is wrong.
fix: Take the exponent table from Telegram's currencies.json (the list tdesktop and the Bot API use) instead of a hand-kept ISO list, and test it against that file.

title: Wallet transaction lookup answer is not matched to the transaction that was clicked
trigger: In a chat, click a Gram transfer card A whose transaction is not in the loaded Money history (open_wallet_transaction sends getTonWalletTransaction, tx_loading = true). Before it answers, click transfer card B (also not in history): a second lookup goes out with tx_loading still true. Alternatively, click a row B in the history list (select_wallet_tx shows B but leaves tx_loading true).
effect: A's answer lands first, passes the only guard (purpose == Transaction && tx_loading, src/state/domains/payments/ton_wallet.rs:72-77) and shows A's details. B's answer then finds tx_loading false and is dropped, or in the history-row case A's late answer replaces B's details. The user clicked B and sees A's amount, address and date.
fix: Make the lookup one value, e.g. `TxDetail { None, Loading { id: String }, Shown(WalletTx), Failed(String) }`. Put the transaction id on the pending request or purpose, and apply an answer only when it matches the `Loading` id.

title: A failed getApplicationConfig for the wallet leaves explorer_url_requested set for the whole session
trigger: Open Settings > Money while getApplicationConfig fails (network error, flood wait). fetch_ton_explorer_url sets explorer_url_requested=true after the send, and RequestPurpose::GetTonExplorerUrl has no error arm that clears it: only purpose.rs and connect/ton_wallet.rs name it. Close and reopen Money.
effect: The request is never asked again this session. ton_usd_rate stays None, so every fiat line on the Money page reads a dash until restart (unless another feature's app-config answer happens to bring the rate). Related: open_money_page sets state_requested and rates_requested before send_wallet(..)?, so a failed send leaves them true too and returns early, skipping the history fetch.
fix: Make the app-config fetch a `Fetch` stage whose error arm (add GetTonExplorerUrl to the payments error routing) moves it back to retryable. Set the flags only after a successful send, or reset them on Err.

title: Reassign click that fails to send leaves the boost box stuck in Working
trigger: Open boost box for a chat with no free slot, reach the Reassign list, tick a slot, click Reassign while the TDLib send fails (connection down / sender error)
effect: driver.reassign_boosts sets phase=Working, note=None, reassigning=Some(..) before send_boost_chat; on Err it returns without restoring, so the box shows the Main body with the Boost button loading+disabled and only Close left. The toast says it could not reassign but the box cannot retry or go back
fix: Set Working only after the send succeeds, or restore the previous phase (Reassign{..}) and clear reassigning on the Err arm (src/connect/groups/boost_flow.rs:61)

title: A failed collectible lookup other than a missing username gives no error
trigger: Tap a phone number row while offline or when TDLib answers any error other than COLLECTIBLE_NOT_FOUND
effect: pump_collectible_info takes the lookup and returns; nothing opens, no note, the tap seems dead
fix: Post StatusNote::error for every failed lookup except the username-not-found copy fallback.

title: Checkout never prefills saved order info or selects the saved card: prefill runs only at open, before the form exists
trigger: Pay once with 'save order info' and a saved card; later press Buy on another invoice. start_invoice_checkout (invoice_checkout.rs:52) sets payments.form = None and opens the dialog right away; open_payment_dialog (payments/mod.rs:33) calls prefill_from_form only if the form is already there, and nothing calls it when the form lands.
effect: Name/phone/email/address fields are empty and the credential choice is 'New card' although TDLib returned saved_order_info and saved_credentials; the user has to retype or reselect everything. The `prefilled` flag is set nowhere else.
fix: Make the checkout a stage value (`Checkout::Loading { dialog } | Ready { dialog, form }`) whose Loading->Ready transition on the form answer runs the prefill; delete the `prefilled` bool.

title: Earn balances are marked asked before the request and never cleared when it fails
trigger: Open a bot or channel profile while offline or while getChatRevenueStatistics/getStarTransactions fails (flood wait, network error), then reopen the profile later.
effect: fetch_earn_balances pushes the peer into balances_asked before sending; the TonBalance/StarBalance error arm is a no-op (payments/earn.rs:473), nothing removes the peer, so the profile's Balance row and the bot-edit Toncoin/Stars rows never appear for that peer until the session is recreated. A send Err after the push has the same effect.
fix: Make the per-peer balance a Fetch<BalanceAmounts> (idle/loading/ready/failed) so an error returns it to idle and the upkeep can retry on reopen.

title: A join box parked for the recipients (EarnState::pending_join) is not dropped by the switch Farewell or by leaving the earn layer, and opens later unasked
trigger: Fresh session: open your own bot's profile, click 'Affiliate Program' (open_bot_affiliate_join, connect/earn.rs:630-652) so the box parks in pending_join while getCreatedPublicChats/getOwnedBots load; before both answer, switch to another account (or close the profile/earn layer and go to another chat). close_earn_boxes only clears pending_join through close_join_box, which runs only when join_box is Some.
effect: When the recipients land (state/domains/payments/earn.rs:407-411) pending_join becomes join_box: the 'Join program' box pops up later on its own, over an unrelated screen, or on switching back to the account.
fix: Make the join box one value, enum JoinBoxStage { Closed, AwaitingRecipients(JoinBox), Open(JoinBox) }, closed whole by close_join_box/Farewell and by leaving the earn surface that asked.

title: Stars withdrawal sends the typed amount without capping it to the available balance or the option maximum
trigger: On a Stars Balance page type an amount above the available Stars (or above star_withdrawal_max) and press Withdraw; earn_withdraw_stars only checks typed < min, while the label already shows 'withdraw all' for typed >= available.
effect: TDLib rejects the URL request; the password-less try then opens the password box for an invalid amount (apply_withdrawal_error 'any other answer'), the user types the 2FA password and gets a 'Failed' toast.
fix: Clamp or reject typed against withdraw_max(limits, available) before start_withdrawal, with the same toast as the minimum.

title: Upgrade-preview fetch is issued from render and retried every second after a failure
trigger: Open an auction info box when getGiftUpgradePreview fails persistently.
effect: auction_info_box calls fetch_gift_upgrade_preview each render; previews stays empty and the error arm is a no-op, so the 1 s animation tick re-sends the request forever while the box is open.
fix: Record a Failed(gift) entry in previews (Fetch<T>) and move the request to the box opener.

title: 'Items bought' box says Loading forever when getGiftAuctionAcquiredGifts fails
trigger: Open an auction where you won gifts, click 'N items bought' while the request fails (offline, server error).
effect: The error arm for AcquiredGifts does nothing, `acquired` never gets the gift id, and the box shows 'Loading...' until closed; no error toast.
fix: Store `acquired` as `HashMap<i64, Fetch<Vec<AcquiredGift>>>` so the error lands in a Failed stage the box shows.

title: Failed listing purchase start in Select Gifts is silent
trigger: In Select Gifts tap a listing while another buy is sending or the driver refuses.
effect: pick_craft_listing ignores Err from start_gift_resale_buy: nothing happens, no note.
fix: Show StatusNote::error on the Err arm.

title: Craft 'Select Gifts' shows 'none on sale' when the listings search failed
trigger: Craft Gift > + (Select Gifts) while searchGiftsForResale fails (offline, server error).
effect: The SearchResale error arm sets search.loading=false, loaded=true, error=Some(..) and pushes no note; craft_select_box never reads `market.error`, so the user is told there are no suitable gifts on sale instead of an error with retry.
fix: Make ResaleSearch's page state `Fetch<..>` and render the Failed stage (message and retry) in the select box.

title: pending_auction opens the auction box after the user closed the send box
trigger: Send-gift box > tap an auction tile (fetch_gift_auction sent, pending_auction=true) > close the send box before the state arrives.
effect: pending_auction is cleared only when the stack empties or the answer lands; it is not tied to the box that asked. When auction_ready arrives the bid/info box opens over nothing, with a recipient captured from the closed send box.
fix: Replace pending_auction with an enum on the market UI (Idle, Opening{auction_id, request}) cancelled when the asking box closes and matched to the answer's request.

title: Cancel / Esc on the transfer confirmation while the transfer is in flight loses the success handling
trigger: Pick a contact > Transfer (a paid transfer) > press Cancel or Esc before the answer lands.
effect: TransferPicker::back() only refuses while export_busy(), not while TransferGift is out, so the stage goes ConfirmPeer -> Pick. apply_gift_manage_ok then finds no ConfirmPeer stage, leaves manage.transferred None and clears the flow: no 'Gift transferred' toast, the recipient's chat is not opened, and the user is shown the list as if nothing happened.
fix: Add a TransferStage::Transferring{user_id,name} variant entered by confirm_picked_transfer; back/Esc are refused there and the answer matches it.

title: A pending 'learn more' value lookup opens its box after the user left the gift
trigger: Open a collectible's gift box or the resale buy box > tap 'learn more' on the Value row > close the box (or switch to another gift/box) before the answer lands.
effect: hub.gift_value is owned by nobody: no close path clears it, GiftValueLookup::land sets open=true for the matching request, and the GiftValue dialog is_open only reads lookup.open. The value box pops up later over whatever is on screen. A failed lookup's error also stays on the row until another click.
fix: Scope the lookup to its host box (gift id) and drop it when that box closes or the gift changes; make loading/ready/failed one Fetch-like enum.

title: Reopening the form resets a launch that is still in flight, so Start can be sent twice
trigger: Prepaid giveaway > Start Giveaway > confirm (launch Launching) > close the dialog > open the same prepaid giveaway again before the answer.
effect: open_giveaway_form sets launch=Idle unconditionally, so launching() no longer matches the old request; the Start button is enabled and a second launchPrepaidGiveaway goes out. The server rejects it and the form shows 'Couldn't start the giveaway' although the first one launched.
fix: Keep Launching{chat,request} across form reopen for the same prepaid id (form opens in a Launching state) instead of resetting it.

title: Countries page shows 'Loading countries' forever when the list fails to load
trigger: Giveaway form > Choose countries while getCountries fails or the send fails (error ignored with let _).
effect: session.auth_state.countries stays None; the page has no error or retry arm, so it shows the loading text until the form is closed.
fix: Use Fetch<Vec<Country>> for the list so the failed arm shows the error and a Retry.

title: Direct Messages box closes as if saved; the failure has nowhere to show
trigger: Channel owner opens Direct messages, turns it on or sets a price, presses Save, and TDLib refuses setChatDirectMessagesGroup.
effect: save_direct_messages takes the box and the button handler closes the dialog at once. PaidSave::Failed is drawn only inside that dialog (error_for(Channel)), so the refusal is never seen and the person thinks it saved.
fix: Keep the box open as a Saving stage of one enum (Editing / Saving / Failed) and close it from the answer; show the failure in the box.

title: Star reaction box closes as sent when the add failed or was refused after render
trigger: Open the Star amount box, then the balance drops or the connection path goes inactive before Send is pressed; press Send.
effect: send_paid_box clears the box first, add_paid ignores the driver Err. The refusal case sets a note, but the InvalidRequest/send_json_request failure paths leave paid.note stale or empty: the box closes, no Stars are added and no error shows (or a stale earlier refusal note shows).
fix: add_paid returns Result<(), PaidRefusal|SendError>; send_paid_box closes the box only on Ok and otherwise keeps it with the error in its own enum stage, instead of the shared PaidReactions::note channel.

title: Premium sticker examples are downloaded only during a fixed 6 second timer poll; a slower answer is never downloaded
trigger: Open a Premium sticker preview (click a Premium sticker without Premium) on a slow connection so getPremiumStickers answers later than 10 x 600 ms.
effect: The loop ends before preview_stickers() has any file id, so no download is requested and the stage keeps the emoji fallback tiles until the page is left and re-entered.
fix: Download the stickers from the reducer when the premium_stickers answer lands (answer-driven), not by a wall-clock poll bounded by a loop count.

title: Preview clip is fetched only if the Premium state arrives within 24 x 250 ms
trigger: Open a Premium feature preview before premium_state is known, on a connection where getPremiumState takes longer than 6 s.
effect: fetch_preview_clip gives up, the animation file is never downloaded and the stage shows the star placeholder for as long as the preview page is open.
fix: Trigger the clip download when premium_state is applied (reducer effect keyed by the shown feature) instead of polling for a fixed time.

title: The Premium bot auto-start survives until some later visit to that bot
trigger: Press Subscribe (Bot route) so auto_start is set, then lose the resolve (switch account before the answer, or the resolve never reaches the chat), and later open the Premium bot by link or search.
effect: hub.auto_start is in the Session, cleared only by the send error and the chat-resolve error arms; take_premium_auto_start matches only the username, so Quill sends '/start <ref>' to the bot with no user action. The background account keeps it too.
fix: Tie it to the resolve request (an Option<RequestId> with the username) and drop it when that request answers or the screen epoch changes.

title: Files chosen for forwarding are taken from the chooser before the chat is known to have opened
trigger: Pick a chat in the Forward to chooser while select_listed_chat does not open it (chat not in the list, filtered or folder-hidden)
effect: choose_start_files_chat does mem::take on choosing, then select_listed_chat; if open_chat_id() != chat it posts a silent Open the chat to attach note and the files are gone, with the chooser closed
fix: Take the files only after open_chat_id() == Some(chat); otherwise keep the chooser open.

title: Files picked for a chat are dropped when that chat does not open synchronously
trigger: Choose a chat in the Forward-to chooser while select_listed_chat cannot open it (open_chat_id() != chat): files were already taken from choosing.
effect: Chooser closes, note 'Open the chat to attach' and the files are lost.
fix: Keep the files until the chat is open (Choosing -> Attaching{chat}), attach on open, restore on failure.

title: Recover waits on request_windowing with no way out
trigger: GPU lost on Windows with no windows left; the windowing request future never completes.
effect: QuitMode::Explicit and no window: the process stays alive invisible, nothing quits.
fix: Give the await an exit (platform error, quit-asked, or a manual-clock deadline) that ends in give_up.
